nodes.label: frontend.core
nodes.desc: Entry namespace for the mobile, browser and Electron apps; start renders the root page component inside the rfx provider.

nodes.label: handler.editor/save-block!
nodes.desc: Editor handlers for save, insert, delete, move and paste; converts UI intent into outliner operations.

nodes.label: outliner.op/save-block!
nodes.desc: Builders that record ops like [:save-block ...] into the dynamic *outliner-ops* accumulator instead of touching the db directly.

nodes.label: outliner.op/transact!
nodes.desc: Runs the accumulated ops as one atomic batch so multi-block edits land together or not at all.

nodes.label: outliner.datascript
nodes.desc: new-outliner-txs-state holds the atom of batch txs collected by the op layer.

nodes.label: outliner.core/save-block
nodes.desc: Primary outliner operations: save-block, insert-blocks, delete-blocks validate blocks against :block/uuid, :block/parent, :block/order and :block/page.

nodes.label: db.transact/enqueue-outliner-mutation!
nodes.desc: Chains per-repo mutations onto a promise tail so concurrent edits stay ordered.

nodes.label: db.transact/apply-outliner-ops
nodes.desc: Ships the op batch to the worker via thread-api/apply-outliner-ops, then flushes returned deltas with react-dom/flushSync.

nodes.label: frontend.handler/start!
nodes.desc: Boot sequence: IndexedDB, plugin setup, IPC listeners, then persist-db runtime start and graph restore.

nodes.label: db.restore/restore-graph!
nodes.desc: Restores a graph from SQLite: opens the schema, resolves sync conflicts and resets renderer subscriptions.

nodes.label: frontend.state
nodes.desc: Application state atom plus <invoke-db-worker, the single bridge from UI thread to worker thread APIs.

nodes.label: frontend.config
nodes.desc: db-version-prefix marks DB graphs, distinguishing the SQLite graph generation from legacy file paths.

nodes.label: worker.db-worker/init
nodes.desc: Browser worker entrypoint that initializes db-core and exposes a Comlink proxy of worker APIs.

nodes.label: db.subs
nodes.desc: Immutable renderer snapshots loaded from the worker-owned graph database; revision-based change detection.

nodes.label: db.subs/<load-block
nodes.desc: Batched slot loads for blocks, children and resources keep the renderer cache warm without full-graph copies.

nodes.label: db.sqlite.create-graph
nodes.desc: Helper fns for creating a DB graph: built-in classes, properties and property-value tx maps.

nodes.label: db.frontend.db
nodes.desc: Graph helpers that read raw datoms, e.g. get-all-properties scans :block/tags avet datoms.

nodes.label: get-page-parents
nodes.desc: Walks :block/parent references, showing the outline tree is a datom graph, not files.

nodes.label: get-storage-conn
nodes.desc: Restores a DataScript connection from its SQLite-backed storage, or creates one with the graph schema.

nodes.label: kvs table
nodes.desc: create-kvs-table! creates (addr, content, addresses) rows used by datascript.storage to persist datoms.

nodes.label: get-db-full-path
nodes.desc: Maps a graph name to its on-disk db.sqlite inside the encoded graph directory.

nodes.label: frontend.persist-db
nodes.desc: Backend of DB based graphs; selects the InBrowser (OPFS) or remote/Electron implementation.

nodes.label: common.file.opfs
nodes.desc: Origin Private File System helpers that read and write graph files directly from the browser.

nodes.label: db.query-dsl/query
nodes.desc: Renderer wrapper for {{query}} strings; execution happens in the db worker via thread-api/query-dsl-query.

nodes.label: db.query-custom/custom-query
nodes.desc: Executes advanced queries through a direct worker API against the graph database.

nodes.label: require-datalog-query!
nodes.desc: Guards that advanced queries are real Datalog vectors starting with :find and free of embedded functions.

nodes.label: logseq.api
nodes.desc: Exported plugin API surface: hooks, slash commands, storage and user settings for plugins.

nodes.label: logseq.api.db-based
nodes.desc: DB version related fns exposed to plugins; pages and properties are edited through outliner core.

nodes.label: logseq.api.block
nodes.desc: Block related apis for plugins, with namespaced plugin.property and plugin.class prefixes.

nodes.label: handler.plugin/setup!
nodes.desc: Installs the plugin host during startup, loading plugin configs and registering commands.

nodes.label: logseq.sdk.core
nodes.desc: SDK namespace re-exported by the plugin api; exports a versioned surface for plugin bundles.
